blocks.text: BAGUIO CITY — Six drug suspects were arrested after Philippine Drug Enforcement Agency-Cordillera (PDEA-CAR) operatives and other law enforcement units dismantled a suspected drug den in Barangay Fairview, Baguio City, on Saturday, Oct. 3. Authorities seized 16 heat-sealed transparent sachets containing suspected shabu (crystal meth), weighing around 11 grams and with an estimated street value of P74,800, along with assorted drug paraphernalia. The operation was conducted in Purok 7, Sunny Side, Barangay Fairview, by PDEA-CAR Regional Special Enforcement Teams Alpha and Bravo, the Baguio City Police Office Drug Enforcement Unit, and Baguio City Police Station 1.
